RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,   April 16, 2010/Chaitra 26, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Human Resource Development; Micro,
Small and Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
93
Recommendations of the Task Force
*301. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of MICRO, SMALL AND
MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has received
the report of the Task Force on micro, small
and medium enterprises that has
recommended changes in policies to help
growth of this sector;
(b) whether the Task Force has also
recommended a road-map for the
development and promotion of this sector
crucial for economic growth and
employment generation; and
(c) if so, whether Government has
considered the suggestions made by the
Task Force?
Disparities in the syllabus of twelfth
standard
†*302. SHRI RAJIV PRATAP RUDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering a new scheme to sort out the
disparities existing in the syllabus of
twelfth standard of State Boards and
Central Board of Secondary Education
(CBSE);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether State Governments have
agreed to this scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Effect of deficient monsoon on
farming community in
Rajasthan
*303. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether less than sufficient
monsoon this year has badly affected the
farming community in Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the consequent loss of
production;
(c) the percentage of the agricultural land
sown under Rabi and Kharif crops;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

94
(d) whether Government has provided
assistance to farmers to deal with the
drought;
(e) if so, the details of the assistance so
far provided to farmers; and
(f) the extent to which the farmers have
been compensated by such assistance?
New railway line from Kadur to
Chikmagalur
†*304. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether former Prime Minister late
Smt. Indira Gandhi had laid foundation
stone for laying new railway line from
Kadur to Chikmagalur in Chikmagalur
district of Karnataka;
(b) whether this railway line has been
completed, if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Spending on higher education
†*305. SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of Gross Domestic
Product (GDP) being spent on education
at present as compared to that of 1990s;
(b) the amount allocated so far out of
the scheme worth Rs. 46,500 crore
formulated for higher education in the
Eleventh Five Year Plan;
(c) whether it is a fact that there is a
constant decrease in Government
investment in education sector; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Import of wheat
*306. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether his Ministry has decided to
extend the time limit for import of wheat
from foreign countries inspite of the fact
that bumper crop is expected this year and
Central pool is full of wheat stocks;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether due to this decision, prices
of wheat in the domestic market have
declined by 2 per cent recently; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Supply of foodgrains to BPL families
†*307. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
any Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) like
proposal under which grains would be
provided to BPL families at a very low rate
to satisfy hunger;
(b) if so, the outlines of the proposed
scheme; and
(c) the number of families living below
the poverty line?
Sale of sub-standard fertilizers,
pesticides, etc.
*308. SHRI G.N. RATANPURI: Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

95
sale and distribution of sub-standard
fertilizers, pesticides, weedicides and
fungicides;
(b) the action taken against the persons/
business houses accused of sale and
distribution of sub-standard agricultural
inputs;
(c) the quantum of such sub-standard
agricultural inputs and the degree of damage
caused by their use; and
(d) whether the relevant provisions of
law are adequate and effective enough to
curb this menace or any amendments in the
law are contemplated?
Fictitious BPL ration cards
*309. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has been
seized of prevalence of fictitious BPL
ration cards in various States resulting in
drawal of inflated volume of subsidized
foodgrains, more than are actually required
by them;
(b) if so, the steps taken for detection
of such fictitious BPL cards and/or any
other  measures taken during the last three
years in order to plug this common means
of pilferage of subsidized foodgrains and
kerosene oil;
(c) the steps taken, if any, to fix
accountability at the States' level as
deterrent to pilferage; and
(d) whether Government is
contemplating any foolproof measures for
plugging loopholes in distribution of
subsidized commodities?
Fees for obtaining ISI certificates
*310. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that present
charges/fees for obtaining ISI certificates
are very high for the small industries;
(b) whether it is also a fact that micro
industries are not in a position to pay such
high fees for obtaining ISI certificates;
(c) whether Government has any plan
to reduce or abolish fees for ISI certification
for at least Micro/SSIs for promotion of
their business; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Agricultural census
*311. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of agricultural
censuses conducted by Government so far;
(b) the total amount spent on
conducting agricultural censuses;
(c) the total financial assistance
provided by the Centre to the State of
Andhra Pradesh under the agricultural
censuses conducted so far; and
(d) the findings of the latest agricultural
census in respect of the State of Andhra
Pradesh?
Appointment of food inspectors in
trains
*312. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the quality,

96
quantity and price of food served in trains
are not upto the expectation of passengers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
appoint food inspectors in the trains to
inspect the quantity, quality, cleanliness
and price of the food served in trains; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Construction of new godowns
*313. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) the present foodgrains storage
capacity of Government agencies in the
country;
(b) whether Government proposes to
construct new godowns for safe storage of
foodgrains to ensure food security in the
country;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any proposals have been
received from the State Governments in
this regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and action
taken on such proposals?
Wastage of foodgrains
†*314. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of foodgrain stocks got
wasted due to lack of proper storage,
transportation and upkeep every year
during the last three years;
(b) the value of foodgrains got so
wasted;
(c) the officers found responsible for
wastage of foodgrains and the action taken
against them;
(d) whether Government will streamline
the system in view of the shortage of
production of foodgrains; and
(e) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard?
Stock of foodgrains
†*315. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether according to the Prime
Minister, the country has substantial stock
of foodgrains because of their record
production and procurement during the
years 2007-08 and 2008-09;
(b) if so, the stocks available at present;
(c) whether the retail prices of
foodgrains have increased by approximately
30 per cent, inspite of the availability of
substantial stock of grains;
(d) whether to control prices,
Government has any plans for sale/
distribution of foodgrains in the open
market;
(e) if so, the stock of foodgrains released
so far in the open market, and the rate
thereof; and
(f) the quantity of foodgrains planned
to be released by Government?
Implementation of debt waiver
scheme
†*316. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has any figures
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

97
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 10th April, 2010 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 20, 1932 (Saka)
on the number of indebted farmers in the
country, State-wise;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of farmers who have been
freed from debt under the loan waiver
scheme, State-wise; and
(d) whether any such case has come to
the notice of Government wherein farmers
who are not covered under the loan waiver
scheme have got loan waiver?
Setting up of vocational educational
institutions
*317. SHRI GOVINDRAO
W AMANRAO ADIK: Will the Minister
of HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any State Government has
sent any proposal to the Central
Government for setting up of various
vocational educational institutions on the
basis of Public-Private-Partnership (PPP),
particularly from the State Governments
of Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details of the proposals
and Government's response thereto;
(c) whether Government has issued any
guidelines for setting up and running of
vocational educational institutions on the
basis of PPP; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of Mid-Day-Meal
Scheme
*318. DR. JANARDHAN
W AGHMARE: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
fact that the Mid-Day-Meal Scheme is not
properly implemented in the schools; and
(b) if so, the steps being taken to
implement it effectively?
Doubling of Delhi-Dehradun line
†*319. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that contrary to
other rail links connecting two major
metropolitan cities, the Delhi-Dehradun rail
section has a single line for nearly 200 km.
stretch;
(b) whether there is any plan of doubling
this important single rail line; and
(c) if so, the time by when this work
would be completed?
Corp Excel awards
*320. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of MICRO, SMALL AND
MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has given Corp
Excel awards to 21 outstanding micro, small
and medium enterprises;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the parameters adopted therefor; and
(d) the steps being taken to encourage
them in such enterprises in the remaining
period of Eleventh Five Year Plan?

I N D EX
(Ministry-wise)
Agriculture : 303, 311, 316,
Chemicals and Fertilizers : 308,
Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution : 306, 307, 309, 310, 313, 314, 315,
Human Resource Development : 302, 305, 317, 318,
Micro, Small and Medium
 Enterprise : 301, 320,
Railways : 304, 312, 319.
Steel : —
GMGIPMRND—1515RS—10.03.2010.
